Eight AI services

Who they help and what they do.

8 items

  • 01Owner / CEO

    AI Executive

    • Daily briefing on cash, receivables, sales and operations
    • Pending approvals and employee exceptions
    • Recommended next actions

    Why it's different · Your morning brief arrives on WhatsApp before the first meeting.

  • 02Sales team

    AI Sales

    • Lead summaries and qualification
    • Follow-up and proposal drafting
    • Quote drafting and next-best action

    Why it's different · Drafts, never sends, without approval.

  • 03Customers & support

    AI Customer Service

    • Website and WhatsApp support
    • FAQ answers and ticket triage
    • Escalation with full history

    Why it's different · Hands off to a person the moment it's unsure.

  • 04Finance

    AI Finance Assistant

    • Invoice extraction
    • Reconciliation assistance and classification suggestions
    • Collections follow-up

    Why it's different · Suggests; deterministic accounting rules decide.

  • 05HR & employees

    AI HR Assistant

    • Policy Q&A and leave guidance
    • Onboarding support and document reminders
    • HR ticket triage

    Why it's different · Answers only from your approved policies.

  • 06Operations

    AI Operations

    • Late work, missing documents and SLA exceptions
    • Workload imbalance
    • Shift and daily summaries

    Why it's different · Flags problems before customers notice them.

  • 07Multiple teams

    AI Document Intelligence

    • Structured data from invoices, POs and delivery notes
    • IDs, contracts and CVs
    • Validated against the record before filing

    Why it's different · Extraction plus validation — not extraction alone.

  • 08Employees

    AI Knowledge Base

    • Answers from SOPs, policies, manuals and contracts
    • Permission-aware: people only see what they're allowed to
    • Product knowledge for sales and support

    Why it's different · The answer respects the asker's permissions.

When to add AI

After the data is reliable.

We add agents only once processes, data and permissions are in place — otherwise AI just makes mistakes faster.

  • Core system works fully without AI
  • Consequential actions pass through permissioned APIs
  • Usage limits keep AI costs predictable
